name: sellpia_shared_product_tags

statements.text:
-- Sellpia shared product/option tags.
--
-- Purpose:
--   - Tags are attached to Sellpia product/option codes, not review queue rows.
--   - Connected seller rows can display the same Sellpia tag.
--   - Existing product_tag_assignments remains a review-row/manual tag feature.

create table if not exists public.sellpia_tag_assignments (
  assignment_id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tag_id uuid not null references public.product_tags(tag_id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
  tag_scope text not null default 'option',
  sellpia_product_code text,
  sellpia_sku_code text,
  reviewer text not null,
  memo text,
  source_file_name text,
  source_row_no integer,
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint ck_sellpia_tag_assignments_scope
    check (tag_scope in ('product', 'option')),
  constraint ck_sellpia_tag_assignments_target
    check (
      (tag_scope = 'product' and nullif(btrim(coalesce(sellpia_product_code, '')), '') is not null)
      or
      (tag_scope = 'option' and nullif(btrim(coalesce(sellpia_sku_code, '')), '') is not null)
    ),
  constraint ck_sellpia_tag_assignments_reviewer
    check (length(btrim(reviewer)) between 1 and 64)
);

create unique index if not exists ux_sellpia_tag_assignments_active_target
  on public.sellpia_tag_assignments (
    tag_id,
    tag_scope,
    coalesce(sellpia_product_code, ''),
    coalesce(sellpia_sku_code, '')
  )
  where is_active = true;

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_tag_assignments_product
  on public.sellpia_tag_assignments(sellpia_product_code, is_active);

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_tag_assignments_sku
  on public.sellpia_tag_assignments(sellpia_sku_code, is_active);

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_tag_assignments_tag
  on public.sellpia_tag_assignments(tag_id, is_active);

alter table public.sellpia_tag_assignments enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "sellpia tag assignments readable" on public.sellpia_tag_assignments;
create policy "sellpia tag assignments readable"
  on public.sellpia_tag_assignments
  for select
  to anon, authenticated
  using (is_active = true);

drop policy if exists "sellpia tag assignments insertable" on public.sellpia_tag_assignments;
create policy "sellpia tag assignments insertable"
  on public.sellpia_tag_assignments
  for insert
  to anon, authenticated
  with check (
    is_active = true
    and length(btrim(reviewer)) between 1 and 64
    and tag_scope in ('product', 'option')
    and (
      (tag_scope = 'product' and nullif(btrim(coalesce(sellpia_product_code, '')), '') is not null)
      or
      (tag_scope = 'option' and nullif(btrim(coalesce(sellpia_sku_code, '')), '') is not null)
    )
  );

drop policy if exists "sellpia tag assignments updatable" on public.sellpia_tag_assignments;
create policy "sellpia tag assignments updatable"
  on public.sellpia_tag_assignments
  for update
  to anon, authenticated
  using (is_active = true)
  with check (
    length(btrim(reviewer)) between 1 and 64
    and tag_scope in ('product', 'option')
  );

grant select, insert, update on public.sellpia_tag_assignments to anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update on public.sellpia_tag_assignments to service_role;
